record.bible_text: Rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> not, O Israel<WH03478>, for joy<WH01524>, as <FI>other<Fi> people<WH05971>: for thou hast gone a whoring<WH02181><WTH8804> from thy God<WH0430>, thou hast loved<WH0157><WTH8804> a reward<WH0868> upon every cornfloor<WH01637><WH01715>. <RF>upon: or, in, etc<Rf>
The floor<WH01637> and the winepress<WH03342> shall not feed<WH07462><WTH8799> them, and the new wine<WH08492> shall fail<WH03584><WTH8762> in her. <RF>winepress: or, winefat<Rf>

They shall not dwell<WH03427><WTH8799> in the LORD'S<WH03068> land<WH0776>; but Ephraim<WH0669> shall return<WH07725><WTH8804> to Egypt<WH04714>, and they shall eat<WH0398><WTH8799> unclean<WH02931> <FI>things<Fi> in Assyria<WH0804>.

They shall not offer<WH05258><WTH8799> wine<WH03196> <FI>offerings<Fi> to the LORD<WH03068>, neither shall they be pleasing<WH06149><WTH8799> unto him: their sacrifices<WH02077> <FI>shall be<Fi> unto them as the bread<WH03899> of mourners<WH0205>; all that eat<WH0398><WTH8802> thereof shall be polluted<WH02930><WTH8691>: for their bread<WH03899> for their soul<WH05315> shall not come<WH0935><WTH8799> into the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068>.
What will ye do<WH06213><WTH8799> in the solemn<WH04150> day<WH03117>, and in the day<WH03117> of the feast<WH02282> of the LORD<WH03068>?

For, lo, they are gone<WH01980><WTH8804> because of destruction<WH07701>: Egypt<WH04714> shall gather them up<WH06908><WTH8762>, Memphis<WH04644> shall bury<WH06912><WTH8762> them: the pleasant<WH04261> <FI>places<Fi> for their silver<WH03701>, nettles<WH07057> shall possess<WH03423><WTH8799> them: thorns<WH02336> <FI>shall be<Fi> in their tabernacles<WH0168>. <RF>destruction: Heb. spoil<Rf> <RF>the...: or, their silver shall be desired, the nettle, etc.: Heb. the desire<Rf><CM>

The days<WH03117> of visitation<WH06486> are come<WH0935><WTH8804>, the days<WH03117> of recompence<WH07966> are come<WH0935><WTH8804>; Israel<WH03478> shall know<WH03045><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> : the prophet<WH05030> <FI>is<Fi> a fool<WH0191>, the spiritual<WH07307> man<WH0376> <FI>is<Fi> mad<WH07696><WTH8794>, for the multitude<WH07230> of thine iniquity<WH05771>, and the great<WH07227> hatred<WH04895>. <RF>spiritual...: Heb. man of the spirit<Rf>

The watchman<WH06822><WTH8802> of Ephraim<WH0669> <FI>was<Fi> with my God<WH0430>: <FI>but<Fi> the prophet<WH05030> <FI>is<Fi> a snare<WH06341> of a fowler<WH03352> in all his ways<WH01870>, <FI>and<Fi>  hatred<WH04895> in the house<WH01004> of his God<WH0430>. <RF>in the: or, against the<Rf>

They have deeply<WH06009><WTH8689> corrupted<WH07843><WTH8765> <FI>themselves<Fi> , as in the days<WH03117> of Gibeah<WH01390>: <FI>therefore<Fi> he will remember<WH02142><WTH8799> their iniquity<WH05771>, he will visit<WH06485><WTH8799> their sins<WH02403>.

I found<WH04672><WTH8804> Israel<WH03478> like grapes<WH06025> in the wilderness<WH04057>; I saw<WH07200><WTH8804> your fathers<WH01> as the firstripe<WH01063> in the fig tree<WH08384> at her first time<WH07225>: <FI>but<Fi> they went<WH0935><WTH8804> to Baalpeor<WH01187>, and separated<WH05144><WTH8735> themselves unto <FI>that<Fi> shame<WH01322>; and <FI>their<Fi> abominations<WH08251> were according as they loved<WH0157><WTH8800>.<CM>

<FI> As for<Fi> Ephraim<WH0669>, their glory<WH03519> shall fly away<WH05774><WTH8709> like a bird<WH05775>, from the birth<WH03205><WTH8800>, and from the womb<WH0990>, and from the conception<WH02032>.

Though they bring up<WH01431><WTH8762> their children<WH01121>, yet will I bereave<WH07921><WTH8765> them, <FI>that there shall<Fi> not <FI>be<Fi> a man<WH0120> <FI>left<Fi> : yea, woe<WH0188> also to them when I depart<WH05493><WTH8800> from them!

Ephraim<WH0669>, as I saw<WH07200><WTH8804> Tyrus<WH06865>, <FI>is<Fi> planted<WH08362><WTH8803> in a pleasant place<WH05116>: but Ephraim<WH0669> shall bring forth<WH03318><WTH8687> his children<WH01121> to the murderer<WH02026><WTH8802>.

Give<WH05414><WTH8798> them, O LORD<WH03068>: what wilt thou give<WH05414><WTH8799>? give<WH05414><WTH8798> them a miscarrying<WH07921><WTH8688> womb<WH07358> and dry<WH06784><WTH8802> breasts<WH07699>. <RF>miscarrying: Heb. that casteth the fruit<Rf>

All their wickedness<WH07451> <FI>is<Fi> in Gilgal<WH01537>: for there I hated<WH08130><WTH8804> them: for the wickedness<WH07455> of their doings<WH04611> I will drive them out<WH01644><WTH8762> of mine house<WH01004>, I will love<WH0160> them no more<WH03254><WTH8686>: all their princes<WH08269> <FI>are<Fi> revolters<WH05637><WTH8802>.

Ephraim<WH0669> is smitten<WH05221><WTH8717>, their root<WH08328> is dried up<WH03001><WTH8804>, they shall bear<WH06213><WTH8799> no fruit<WH06529>: yea, though they bring forth<WH03205><WTH8799>, yet will I slay<WH04191><WTH8689> <FI>even<Fi> the beloved<WH04261> <FI>fruit<Fi> of their womb<WH0990>. <RF>the...: Heb. the desires<Rf>
My God<WH0430> will cast them away<WH03988><WTH8799>, because they did not hearken<WH08085><WTH8804> unto him: and they shall be wanderers<WH05074><WTH8802> among the nations<WH01471>.<CM>
